definitions.full: H5177. Nachshon נַחְשׁוֺן proper name, masculine son of Aminadab, of Judah, brother-in-law of Aaron Exod 6:23 ; Num 1:7 ; 2:3 ; 7:12 , 17 ; 10:14 (all P), Ruth 4:20 (twice in verse); 1Chr 2:10-11 , ᵐ5 Ναασσων (DHM ZMG xxxvii (1888), 15 compare Sabean tribal name נחסן ).
